title: Backups and rollback
description: Snapshots of the modpack files and the mod settings. The manager takes an automatic one before every update and keeps the latest three; the ones you take yourself are kept apart (up to ten).
emptyHint: Take a snapshot before experimenting with the settings — a rollback brings the modpack and its settings back.
restoreTitle: Roll back to the snapshot of {date}?
restoreDescription: The modpack files and its settings return to the snapshot, and so do other mods the install removed. Mods added later stay in place. The game must be closed.
deleteDescription: Files in the game stay as they are.
